assertions.name: rho_k_routes_agree
assertions.source: The simple form `ρ_K = m_p / (m_e · |tr_M|)` and the linking_weight form `ρ_K = linking_weight · (Vol/ℏ_q²) / |tr_M|` MUST agree by algebra. This assertion confirms they do.

assertions.name: rho_k_matches_doc_quoted_value
assertions.source: Empirical ρ_K^𝔭 computed in this audit should match the value 1723.6 quoted in atom-knot-mass-derivation.md line 7.

description: Substrate-derivation audit for the proton's categorical density ρ_K. Companion to PR #1272 — traces through the canonical 6-term mass-endomorphism formula at q₀ and shows that linking_weight and ρ_K parameterize the same closure problem. Reads existing 6-term + term-6 witnesses; computes implied ρ_K via two routes (simple form `m_p / (m_e · |tr_M|)` and linking_weight form) and verifies they agree. The pair-gen substrate-component of ρ_K (per prop:rho-k-graded-expansion) is the OPEN derivation that would close the per-knot VolDensity gap categorically.

graded_substrate_expansion_status.LO_piece_status: PROVED (Wenzl 1988 Markov multiplicativity) but trivial for A=1 — reduces to m_p itself. Substantive only for A≥2 multi-nucleon binding chain.
graded_substrate_expansion_status.single_gen_piece_status: EMPIRICAL: closes to ~0.18% per atomic-mass-gb-nf §rho_K closure. Categorical derivation NOT yet completed.
graded_substrate_expansion_status.pair_gen_piece_status: OPEN: this is the conjectural `rho_K_pair_gen` of prop:rho-k-graded-expansion / conj:rho-k-pair-gen-canonical-form. Substrate-only derivation of this piece would close the per-knot VolDensity gap categorically — same problem as `derive linking_weight` (re-parameterised).
